labels.lesson.title: Disagree Constructively and Move the Discussion Forward
labels.section.title: Recognise a Reason Without Pretending to Agree
labels.distinction.note: Understanding a reason is not accepting a proposal
labels.quote.maya: An answer tool can save time when we get stuck. I would use it as soon as a problem becomes difficult.
labels.agreement.phrase: I agree that we should use it immediately.
labels.honesty.rule: Be accurate about your own position
labels.reflection.prompt: What can you recognise without accepting the proposal?
labels.choice.position: Time matters; immediate help raises a concern
labels.shared.criteria: Use time well · understand the reasoning
labels.response.check: What do you recognise? What do you question?
labels.acknowledgement.optional: Recognition is a resource, not a required opener
labels.private.prompt: Express the given position in your own words
labels.review.question: Does the reply express the intended position?
labels.next.title: Next: explain the concern precisely
labels.branch.a.label: Accepts the proposed timing
labels.branch.a.note: Does this match the assigned position?
labels.branch.b.label: Recognises the reason; states the concern
labels.branch.b.note: A clearer difference; no agreed method
labels.branch.c.label: A personal judgement, not an explanation
labels.branch.c.note: Explain the concern; do not diagnose the person
